correctness.rationale: Sorted row weights model S_n orbit chamber B as product-simplex union, with straight-line contraction. Odd column stabilizers exactly where two columns coincide, producing parity double cells only at interval-support compositions n or n−1. Difference cellular chain D_d=Z^{C(n-1,m-1)}, D_{d−1}=Z^{C(n-2,m-1)} with boundary ±1 on decrement coordinates. Selecting columns b+e_m gives triangular unimodular submatrix, so D has free top homology C(n-2,m-2). For d≥2 the known Hom(K_m,K_n) wedge theorem and Armstrong 3-cycle fixed points imply pi1 of alternating orbit zero; Whitehead yields wedge of S^d. d0 and d1 separately handled.
